name: clock-travel-12h-east
description: Six hours on a 0.85 U/hr profile across a trip twelve hours east: the pump's clock starts twelve hours behind the phone's and is set twelve hours ahead on its screen 180 minutes ago (TimeChanged and, across midnight, DateChange), so it ends on the phone's time. Before it, a 2.0 U pump bolus 240 minutes ago and a 150% temp rate from 200 minutes ago that ends after the change; after it, a 1.0 U pump bolus 90 minutes ago, so the records either side of the change are stamped on different clocks.
